---
name: Feature or improvement
about: A new skill, workstation, or capability you'd like to see.
title: '[FEATURE] '
labels: enhancement
---

## What this does

One sentence: what does the proposed feature do?

## Why

What problem does this solve? What's the alternative today (workaround, or "not possible")?

## Where it would live

- New skill at `.claude/skills/<name>/`?
- New workstation folder?
- New `docs/` page?
- Changes to an existing file?

## Sketch (optional)

If you have an early sketch of the skill's steps, the workstation's CLAUDE.md, or the docs page, paste it here.

## Scope check

Per `CONTRIBUTING.md`, contributions that **sharpen the opinionation** are preferred. This feature:

- [ ] Adds a new capability without removing existing opinionation
- [ ] Removes opinionation (Quality Gate, Spotlight Rule, Disposable Noise, Zone C decomposition) - if so, explain why
- [ ] Generalizes the system to cover a new use case
- [ ] Adapts to a non-Claude client
